curios.description: Pinned target, full schemas and safe workflow. Does not touch the game.

offset.description: Default 0. Fresh live offset page; not an atomic snapshot. Keep filters unchanged.

limit.description: Default 32, maximum 64 rows. Total capability rows bounded to 4096.

identifier.description: Optional exact Curios identifier from slots, e.g. ring. Not a resource ID or menu index.

index.description: Optional exact index within that identifier's stack handler.

cosmetic.description: Optional filter for slots; candidates default false. Cosmetic handler is a separate namespace.

curios.menu.description: Current menu/session/state/cursor, real menu slots, main inventory and pending operation. Does not open a screen.

inventory_slot.description: Actual player main inventory index; 0..8 are hotbar. Does not scan registry or server storage. Native predicates are client-only hints.

session.description: Fresh token from curios.menu; binds real world/player/connection/menu/screen/capability, page/grid and slot objects; expires after 30 seconds.

menu_id.description: Exact current menu ID, including player menu ID for open.

state_id.description: Exact current menu state from same observation; not a server success signal.

request_id.description: UUID for one operation. Same UUID + same payload returns retained receipt for 120 seconds, max 512. Never retry submitted under a new UUID.

dry_run.description: Default true. false explicitly submits once after identical checks. No stack/UI writes or packets during dry-run.

curios.open.description: Only no screen + current player inventory menu + empty cursor. One native CPacketOpenCurios(EMPTY). Observe until Curios v2 is actually open.

intent.description: equip = empty Curio/nonempty hotbar; unequip = nonempty Curio/empty hotbar; exchange = both nonempty. Entire stacks only.

expected_curio_stack_hash.description: Full ItemStack.save SHA-256 including ForgeCaps, ordinary NBT, type/order and full int count, including empty stacks.

expected_stack_hash.description: Exact functional Curio item stack hash from menu. Cosmetic slots are deliberately rejected.

workflow: Observe curios.slots without opening a screen.
Observe curios.menu; if originally closed, explicitly open then wait/read back.
Use actual menu_slot + identifier/index/cosmetic and both stack hashes. Dry-run then submit a hotbar swap.
Observe exact two-stack result. Keep an initially open menu open. Explicit close only if caller intends to restore gameplay.
limitations: Client-synced state only; unknown handlers remain read-only and unknown predicates are null.
No arbitrary stack setters, slot resizing, off-page guessed IDs, automatic open/swap/close wrapper, multi-pickup, arbitrary inventory swap or other mods' global skill keys.
Non-hotbar source/destination: caller first uses core container.move to stage it in hotbar.
Native packet has no expected item/hash fields; client checks cannot remove server/network races.
submitted is never server success. Re-read; uncertain sends are never automatically retried.
Page, cosmetic view and render use underlying toggle packets. One pending menu operation blocks additional mutations until relevant observation/context change; close remains available.
